source: 772 Curse
target: 772 Maledictio

source: Filled with the courage to battle against the heavens and to strike at true gods, Lumian stood straight and tall, unflinchingly facing the ruined palaces within the Pale-White Nation.
target: Virtute ad certandum contra caelos et deos veros percutiendos imbutus, Lumian rectus et altus stetit, impavidus ruinas palatiorum intra Nationem Pallide-Albam spectans.

source: Just then, his eyelids dropped uncontrollably, shielding his eyes.
target: Tandem, palpebrae eius sine moderamine ceciderunt, oculos eius tegentes.

source: Almost simultaneously, the voice of the Knight of Swords resonated once more in his ear: “Our target is Oxyto’s child, not the ancient god’s corpse.”
target: Fere simul, vox Eques Gladii iterum in aurem eius resonavit: “Meta nostra est proles Oxyto, non corpus dei antiqui.”

source: This was to prevent Lumian from looking directly across the pale‐white wilderness at the corpse of the ancient death god.
target: Hoc adhibitum est ut Lumian non directe per desertum pallide album corpus dei mortis antiqui intueretur.

source: “There’s nothing to fear!” Lumian quickly responded.
target: “Nihil metuendum est!” Lumian celeriter respondit.

source: His voice, once it left his mouth, was also “infected” by the pallor governing this world, becoming weak, hollow, and devoid of emotion.
target: Vox eius, semel e ore prolata, a pallore huius mundi imperante infecta est, infirmis, inanis, et affectibus carentibus.

source: The Knight of Swords earnestly advised, “But this will affect our battle with Oxyto’s child; we must resolve it quickly. Once that’s done, you can do whatever you want.”
target: Eques Gladii sincere monuit: “Sed hoc nostram pugnam cum prole Oxyto afficiet; celeriter id solvere oportet. Postea, quidquid vis facere poteris.”

source: Lumian fell momentarily quiet before responding, “Okay.”
target: Lumian paulisper tacuit antequam respondit: “Bene.”

source: Honestly, wearing the Eggers family’s golden mask and in his undead state, Lumian felt a bloodline‐based fear and an awe towards the Phoenix Ancestor’s corpse atop Death’s palace, which the courage did not dispel and even somewhat weakened, creating a balance.
target: Vere, larvam auream familiae Eggers gerens et in statu inter vivos et mortuos versans, Lumian timorem ex stirpe et reverentiam erga corpus progenitoris Phoenicis, super palatium Mortis, sensit, quod virtus non expulit sed etiam paulo attenuat, aequilibrium creando.

source: Otherwise, Lumian, wielding the Sword of Courage, would not have been so agreeable!
target: Alioquin, Lumian, Gladium Virtutis gerens, non tam obsequiosus fuisset!

source: Immediately, Lumian ignited into a bright white flame, transforming into a long spear of light, hurling towards the still‐intact buildings at the edge of the palace complex.
target: Statim, Lumian in splendida flamma alba accensus est, in longam hastam lucis mutatus, ad aedificia adhuc integra in margine complexus palatii iactatus est.

source: As the fiery spear cut through the sky, it too was eroded by the pallor, dissipating and dimming even faster, which meant Lumian only managed half the intended distance.
target: Dum hasta ignita per caelum secabat, ea quoque a pallore erodebatur, celerius dissipata et obscurata, quod significabat Lumian solam dimidiam partem itineris destinati assecutum esse.

source: Finally, as the pale‐white light extinguished, Lumian appeared mid‐air, plummeting straight towards the ground.
target: Denique, cum lux pallide alba exstinxit, Lumian in medio aëris apparuit, directe ad terram labens.

source: He landed softly on the wilderness, making only a slight sound, and all around was deadly silence.
target: Suavi modo in deserto terram contigit, leviter sonum edens, et undique silentium mortiferum regnabat.

source: The bright, blazing spear of flame took to the air once again.
target: Hasta flammae candida et fulgida iterum in aethera advolavit.

source: After repeating this five times, Lumian finally reached a high tower adorned with numerous golden patterns and stood at its top, with the figure of Oxyto’s monstrous child becoming clearer in his sight.
target: Quinque vice id repetens, Lumian denique turrim altam, multis figuris aureis ornatam, attingit et in summo stetit, cum imago proles monstruosae Oxyto in conspectu eius clare appareret.

source: Although the other did not display the potentially incomplete Mythical Creature form, merely seeing the bent human limbs, a head formed from several merged infant heads, and wings stretching from the torso with half pale‐white, half chestnut‐brown feathers, Lumian felt dizzy, accompanied by spasmodic pain.
target: Quamquam ille formam creaturae mythicae, fortasse imperfectam, non ostendebat, cum solum videret membra humana flecta, caput ex pluribus capitibus infantum coniunctum, et alas a torace protractas, quarum plumae dimidio pallide albae et dimidio castaneo‐brunnea erant, Lumian vertiginem sensit, comitatus dolore spasmodico.

source: Additionally, something inside him seemed to be calling, slowly gathering towards his abdomen.
target: Praeterea, aliquid intus in eo videbatur vocare, lente in directionem abdominis eius congregans.

source: It was the bloodline of Omebella!
target: Erat stirps Omebellae!

source: Lumian felt no fear from this.
target: Lumian ex hoc nullum timorem sensit.

source: Wasn’t this inevitable?
target: Nonne hoc ineluctabile erat?

source: In the next instant, two figures materialized before him.
target: In proximo momento duo figurae ante eum apparuerunt.

source: One figure wore a black Gothic‐style court dress, complete with a matching petite bonnet and her light golden hair neatly bundled up; the other, slightly disheveled, donned a traditional black vest over a white shirt.
target: Una figura induta erat vestimento curiae Gothicum nigrum, cum parva bonnet congruente et capillis aureis levibus diligenter compositis; altera, paulo incondita, loricam nigrum traditam super camisiam albam induit.

source: Temperance faction demigod Sharron and a member of the temperance faction, the holder of the Knight of Swords Minor Arcana tarot card, Maric!
target: Semideus factionis temperantiae, Sharron, et membrum eadem factionis, tenens chartam tarot “Eques Gladii Arcana Minor”, Maric!

source: As they approached their primary target, they finally detached from Lumian’s body, ready to battle.
target: Dum ad metam principalem accedebant, tandem ex corpore Lumiani se separaverunt, ad pugnam paratos.

source: Indeed, both Sharron and Maric bore colors derived from the impressions left by Lumian, not truly manifested, appearing pale‐white and dim.
target: Revera, et Sharron et Maric colores gerebant ex vestigiis a Lumiano relictis, qui vere non manifesta erant, apparentes pallide albos et exiguo lumine.

source: Moreover, their bodies were transparent and ghostly, in a state of Wraiths.
target: Praeterea, corpora eorum erant translucida et quasi phantasmatica, in statu umbrarum.

source: If not so, they would have instantly died, becoming real undead creatures devoid of consciousness.
target: Nisi ita fuisset, statim interfecti essent, facti essent creaturae mortuorum verae, conscientia carentes.

source: The monstrous child of Oxyto, hovering close to the belly of the ancient death god’s corpse, sensed the proximity of Lumian and the others.
target: Proles monstruosa Oxyto, prope ventrem corporis dei mortis antiqui volitans, propinquitatem Lumiani et ceterorum sensit.

source: From a distance of two or three kilometers, it half‐turned its body and looked over with its twelve clustered eyes.
target: Ex distantia duorum vel trium chiliometrorum, corpus eius semi‐vertit et per duodecim oculos congregatos intuebatur.

source: Lumian immediately felt the protective essence of his mind and consciousness, shielded by the Eggers family’s golden mask, along with the life force deep within, showing signs of disintegration.
target: Lumian statim sensit essentiam protectivam mentis et conscientiae suae, ab aurea larva familiae Eggers tegente, una cum vi vitae intima quae signa disintegrationis exhibebat.

source: In his eyes, the temperance faction demigod named Sharron, using the reflective mirror effect of the pure gold surface, flickered twice between the crumbling palace and the high tower, coming within three to four hundred meters of the Phoenix Ancestor’s corpse.
target: In oculis eius, semideus factionis temperantiae nomine Sharron, utens speculi reflexo effectu ex superficie puro auri, bis inter palatium ruentem et turrim altam micavit, ad corpus progenitoris Phoenicis intra trecentos ad quadringentos metra accessit.

source: She opened her mouth towards Oxyto’s child and emitted a piercing scream.
target: Os suum ad prolem Oxyto direxit et clamorem acutum edidit.

source: This was Lumian’s first time hearing Sharron’s voice.
target: Hoc fuit primum tempus quo Lumian vocem Sharronis audivit.

source: Eroded by the pallor during its journey of over two thousand meters, the sound reached Lumian’s ears as a faint echo, almost like an illusion.
target: Pallore in itinere plus quam duorum milia metrorum eroditus, sonus ad aures Lumiani pervenit ut tenuus echo, fere quasi illusio.

source: Oxyto’s child didn’t see it that way.
target: Proles Oxyto id non ita videbat.

source: The feathers on its wings—half pale‐white, half chestnut‐brown—rapidly fell off.
target: Plumæ in alis eius—dimidio pallide albae, dimidio castaneo‐brunnea—celeriter delapsae sunt.

source: One by one, the eyes on its face burst open, the flesh on its uncovered body festering down to the bone, as if struck by a potent curse!
target: Uno post alium, oculi in facie eius erupti sunt, et caro in corpore nudato putrida usque ad ossa, quasi potenti maledictō icta esset!

source: Seeing this, Lumian, fearless, transformed once again into the fiery spear of flame and hurled himself at the creature.
target: Hoc videns, Lumian, impavidus, iterum in hastam flammae ardentis se transformavit et in creaturam iactavit.

source: Meanwhile, the Knight of Swords flickered forward on various reflective surfaces.
target: Interim, Eques Gladii per varias superficies reflectas micavit.

source: Oxyto’s child let out a mournful howl.
target: Proles Oxyto ululatum maeroris edidit.

source: Though distant and further muted by the dense pallor within Death’s palace, the sound was soft when it reached Lumian, yet it still made him dizzy for a moment, a bloody stench of decay filling his nostrils, involuntarily causing him to revert from his fiery spear form.
target: Quamquam procul et a denso pallore in palatio Mortis attenuatus, sonus ad Lumian perveniens lenis erat, sed tamen eum paulisper vertiginem afflixit, fetore cruenti putredinis naribus eius impleto, quod inviti eum ex forma hastae flammae recedere coegit.

source: With this howl, Oxyto’s monstrous child morphed into a writhing, twisted, huge pale‐white bud.
target: Hoc ululatu, proles monstruosa Oxyto in germen immane, tortuosum, pallide album se transformavit.

source: The exploded eyeballs, festering flesh, and fallen feathers were all absorbed into the bud.
target: Oculi, quae eruptae sunt, caro putrescens, et plumæ lapsae omnes in gemen absorpti sunt.

source: In a blink, the bud blossomed, sopping wet, and produced two children.
target: In momento, germen floruit, madidum, et duo proles peperit.

source: One was intertwined in pitch‐black and dark red, its sores festering rapidly until it stilled, turned pale, and fell to the ground; the other was an unscathed, massive bird‐clawed monstrosity.
target: Unus intricatus erat in atris nigro et rubro obscuro, cuius ulcera celeriter putrescere coeperunt, donec quietus factus, pallide redditus, et in terram cecidit; alter erat intactus, ingens monstrum cum unguibus avium.

source: Through this transformation, Oxyto’s monstrous child shed the curse and was reborn.
target: Per hanc transformationem, proles monstruosa Oxyto maledictionem abiecit et renata est.

source: But Sharron seized the moment, her figure reflected within its clustered twelve eyes.
target: Sed Sharron momentum arripuit, cum figura eius in oculis duodecim conglobatis repraesentata esset.

source: Oxyto’s monstrous child froze mid‐air, just a few dozen meters from the Death’s main hall where the Phoenix Ancestor’s corpse lay.
target: Proles monstruosa Oxyto in aere immota stetit, paulo decem metris ab aula principali Mortis, ubi corpus progenitoris Phoenicis iacebat.

source: In its twelve gleaming beautiful eyes, the figure of Sharron, wearing her petite bonnet, flickered in and out of view, soon illuminated by intense, bright white light.
target: In duodecim oculis nitidis eius, figura Sharronis, parva bonnet gerens, inter praesentiam et evanitionem micavit, mox luce intensa, candida et alba illustrata.

source: A flamboyant spear of flame shot forth, striking an ancient, partially collapsed tower nearby.
target: Hasta flammae fulgida exsurgit, proximam turrim antiquam, partim collabentem, percutiens.

source: As the light dispersed, Lumian, single‐handedly wielding the Sword of Courage, appeared.
target: Dum lux dispersa est, Lumian, solus gladium Virtutis gerens, apparuit.

source: He did not hesitate or feel fear.
target: Non cunctatus est neque timorem sensit.

source: Despite the dizziness and pain in his head, his eyes turned an iron‐black.
target: Non obstante vertigine et dolore in capite, oculi eius in nigro ferreo versaverunt.

source: This iron‐black shade emerged only to be eroded by the pallor, harmonizing completely with this nation.
target: Haec umbra nigro ferrea emersit solum ut pallore eroderetur, perfecte huic nationi congruens.

source: This did not impede Lumian’s observation of his target’s weaknesses, though all he saw was pallor.
target: Hoc non impedit Lumian ut infirmitates scopī eius observeret, nam nihil nisi pallorem vidit.

source: Compelled, Lumian relied on his Hunter kin senses to detect weaknesses, picking the most appealing and battle‐raging spot among those pale hues.
target: Coactus, Lumian sensibus cognationis venatorum innitens ad infirmitates detegendas, eligebat locum maxime amoenum et certaminis fervorem exhibentem inter illa pallida signa.

source: Once again, he became the increasingly pale and dimming fiery spear of flame, positioning himself above Oxyto’s monstrous child.
target: Iterum, factus est hasta flammae ardens, crescente palliditate et obscuritate, se posito super prolem monstruosam Oxyto.

source: His figure outlined; he grasped the Sword of Courage, blazing with bright white and blue flames, and plummeted like a boulder towards the body of Oxyto’s monstrous child.
target: Figura eius delineata; gladium Virtutis arripuit, fulgens cum flammis candidae et caeruleae, atque ut lapis ingens versus corpus proles monstruosae Oxyto labens ruavit.

source: As they drew close, Lumian struck at the monstrous bird‐clawed infant’s abdomen with his broadsword, now tainted with pallor.
target: Dum propius accederent, Lumian ad abdominum infantis monstrosi, cui unguibus avium attributus erat, gladio lato, iam pallore contaminato, percussit.

source: He was using his Cull.
target: Hunc modum, “Cull”, adhibuit.

source: Before this, the Knight of Swords, Maric, appeared atop the half‐collapsed tower, slipping on a ring carved in the shape of the sun god’s bird.
target: Ante hoc, Eques Gladii Maric in summo turrim semidemolitam apparuit, induens annulum, sculptum in forma avis dei solis.

source: In his hands, he quickly formed a lance as clear as pure sunlight.
target: In manibus eius, celeriter hastam paravit, tam perspicuam quam solis purae lumen.

source: This caused the nearby pallor to fade slightly, erasing shadows and causing the Wraith‐like state of the Knight of Swords to melt inch by inch. Droplets of dim liquid fell like wax in a fire.
target: Hoc effecit ut pallor proximus paullo evanuerit, umbras tollens et statum umbralem Eques Gladii passu passu dissoluens. Guttae liquidae obscurae, similes cerae in igne, cadebant.

source: The droplets evaporated quickly, leaving behind a bit of dust that slowly dispersed.
target: Guttae celeriter evanuerunt, relinquentes paulum pulveris quod lente dispersum est.

source: Enduring the melting of his right side, Maric’s expression twisted into one of madness as he hurled the lance of sunlight towards Oxyto’s monstrous child.
target: Dextro latus fusum sustinens, vultus Marici in insanitate contortus est, dum hastam solis in prolem monstruosam Oxyto iactabat.

source: Considering that Oxyto was a Shaman King of the Moon pathway, the temperance faction had prepared a Sun pathway Sealed Artifact in advance, which unexpectedly proved useful at this time!
target: Cum Oxyto esset Shamanus Rex viae Lunae, factionis temperantiae praeparaverat sigillatum artifactum viae Solis, quod in hoc tempore inopinato utile fuit!

source: This Sealed Artifact, both in effect and trait, would bring significant harm to the Wraiths.
target: Hoc Artifactum Sigillatum, et in effectu et in indole, nocentiam notabilem umbris afferet.

source: The clean and bright spear of flame became an anomaly in this pale world.
target: Hasta flammae pura et candida facta est insolita in hoc mundo pallido.

source: It too was being eroded, but it was also dispersing the pallor, appearing to be able to strike the body of the monster child before Lumian’s Sword of Courage could.
target: Ea quoque erodebatur, sed simul pallorem dispergebat, apparens se posse corpus proles monstrosae percutere antequam gladium Virtutis Lumiani feriret.

source: Although the monstrous child of Oxyto was possessed by the demigod Sharron and forcibly controlled, it wasn’t completely turned into a statue to be slaughtered at will.
target: Quamquam proles monstruosa Oxyto a semideo Sharron possessa et vim adhibitam subiecta erat, non plane in statuam versam erat, ut ad caedem ad arbitrium parata esset.

source: It struggled against the influence of the Wraith, as its “reborn” body slowly contracted, seemingly returning to an embryonic state, seeking the comfort of its mother’s embrace, while unleashing its own Paramita.
target: Contra vim umbrarum certabat, dum corpus eius “renatum” lente contractum est, quasi ad statum embryonicum rediens, consolationem amplexus matris quaerens, dum propriam suam Paramitam efferebat.

source: The pale‐white wilderness quickly engulfed the surrounding ruined palaces and the half‐collapsed tower, also drawing the bodies of a few Blessed of Death who had died in this area into its scope.
target: Deserta pallide alba celeriter absorpsit palatia ruinas circumstantia et turrim semidemolitam, trahens etiam corpora paucorum Beatorum Mortis qui hic perierant.

source: In the deathly silence, a horrific giant snake, bearing only bones and some rotting flesh with exaggerated wings, sprung from the collapsed palace into the air, blocking the path of the Knight of Swords’ spear of sunlight.
target: In silentio mortifero, horrendus serpens gigas, qui tantum ossa et carnem putrescens cum alis amplis portabat, ex palatio collapso in aethera exsiluit, iter hastae solis Eques Gladii impediens.

source: The blinding sunlight burst forth, filling Lumian’s eyes.
target: Sol obcaecans erupit, oculos Lumiani implevit.

source: His strike with the Sword of Courage did not slow down; he firmly slashed downwards.
target: Ictus eius cum Gladio Virtutis non tardavit; firmiter deorsum secavit.

source: The sunlight blackened his pale, dim skin, sparking a burning smoke.
target: Lux solis cutem pallidam et opacam eius nigravit, producens fumum ardentem.

source: A soft “clang” sounded as Lumian’s Sword of Courage struck the head of the winged giant snake, splitting the target, which had become exceptionally fragile after absorbing most of the sunlight damage.
target: Mollis “clang” resonavit cum gladium Virtutis Lumiani caput serpens gigantis alatae percutit, scissum obiectum, quod post absorptionem plerisque damni solis maxime fragili factum erat.

source: In a barely audible silence, the snake’s bones either evaporated or shattered, completely losing their support and falling like rain to the ground.
target: In silentio vix audibili, ossa serpens vel evanescebant vel confracta sunt, omnino subsidium amittens et quasi pluvia in terram cadentes.

source: With the help of the giant bone snake blocking a strike for him, Oxyto’s monstrous child controlled by Sharron contracted even more fiercely.
target: Auxilio ossium serpentis gigantis, qui ictum eius impediebat, proles monstruosa Oxyto, ab Sharron regita, etiam vehementius contracta est.

source: Its half pale‐white, half chestnut‐brown wings and bent limbs had merged with its body, forming a sphere, with only its head, formed from several merged infant heads, still visible.
target: Alæ dimidio pallide albae et dimidio castaneo‐brunnea atque membra flecta cum corpore eius coalescebant, sphaeram formantes, cum capite solum, ex pluribus capitibus infantum coniuncto, adhuc visibili.

source: Its Paramita then encompassed the entire main hall of Death and the corpse of the Phoenix Ancestor.
target: Deinde eius Paramita totum atrium principale Mortis et corpus progenitoris Phoenicis complexi amplectebatur.
